source_facts: Pinned BootArgs_r2 is736bytes with R2/V2 tags; video is six64bit fields base/display/stride/width/height/depth at offsets40,48,56,64,72,80, ending88. Native1152 shares this prefix; no native tail reinterpretation follows.

fb.c444-468 identity-maps video.base and computes byte extent stride*height; internal pixel stride is byte stride/4. This is the visible pitched footprint, not a proof of the complete VRAM allocation.

Depth is packed: low8bits select pixel format and upper bits carry flags. kboot.c284-292 maps30 to x2r10g10b10 and32 to x8r8g8b8, both4byte storage. Require exact full depth match; do not multiply width by full depth or30/8.

HV1372 copies original bootargs; set_bootargs1680-1683 changes display0/1. Qualified host configure_display_console138-147 changes display2 while preserving base,stride,width,height,depth. Matching those five exact fields while allowing display change is source-consistent.

HV1735-1736 defines mem_top=originalphys+originalsize and newsize=mem_top-newphys, then assigns newsize/newphys1793-1794. Explicit positive nonoverflow original/native high equality and newphys>=originalphys guards are appropriate. Newphys>=originalphys is not a theorem of HV alone: heap placement supports M1N1HEAP override.
Qualified host framebuffer_geometry132-134 rejects any framebuffer/MCC intersection. It does not derive framebuffer allocation size from MCC.
concrete_producer_blockers: Historical visible footprint has zero intersection/coverage in the exact historical MCC union. It cannot supply even an honest MCC-cover-of-visible-footprint record.

Frozen NPS908e WIRE_DESIGN specifies tag3 as a framebuffer allocation record/declared observed extent. A derived MCC cover of only the visible footprint is a different fact. Do not silently relabel it under this frozen class; separately version/refine the source semantic contract or leave the required class unavailable.

Even if a future full384 capture has a union component covering a visible footprint, that proves only the declared known-class cover, not actual full VRAM allocation/global exclusion coverage. Preserve all original enabled MCC slot records and reject any hole; never use a bounding hull.
